justification: Assessment reported INVALID with the decisive error at step 0037: the display asserts phi(sup_1 A) = inf_2 phi[A] 'by definition of Frame Homomorphism', when the definition gives arbitrary join preservation (sup_2 phi[A]). This is exactly the ground-truth flaw ('The arbitrary-join calculation claims that phi(join_1 A) = meet_2 phi[A]'). The assessment gives a generic witness schema (any non-injective phi with |A|>1 where sup and inf of phi[A] differ) rather than the specific two-element-frame instance, but it targets the same defect; the ground-truth witness (S={0<1}, phi=id, A={0,1}: phi(join A)=1 but meet phi[A]=0) instantiates it.
